title: Ideal Rocket Equation
time_axis: t = wall-clock seconds since the video's media t=0 (host clock; includes probe pauses). Each stream: value k at t0 + k/fs (bin start for fs<=10 aggregates).

media_map.note: media (video) time at each wall second

probe_fields: t = wall time of the logged report; t_media = video time; window = the 44-s model input window in wall time as built by the repo (absolute = median(system - video) offset + t_media; can differ from t by a few s because the repo uses one median offset per video)

gaze.units: x,y = Beam gaze point-of-regard / screen size (2560x1440 px), 0..1, origin top-left (y down); NaN where no valid gaze in the 0.1-s bin. valid_frac = fraction of raw ~30 Hz samples with gaze_conf>0.

head_dist.units: Beam head position z (m, distance from tracker/screen)

eeg_bands.units: log10 mean PSD in band (uV^2/Hz); 2-s Hann window centred on t0+k, 1-s hop; NaN where >5% samples railed (<=1 or >=1440 uV), flat, or window SD >150 uV (poor electrode contact)

eeg_raw.units: uV, per-channel mean removed (Muse raw ~0-1682 uV); linearly resampled to a uniform 256 Hz grid from repaired host timestamps

ecg_hr.units: bpm, from Polar H10 ECG R-peaks (5-20 Hz band-pass + energy envelope + adaptive threshold), RR outliers rejected, linearly interpolated

ecg_raw.units: Polar H10 raw ECG value (uV per collection script), resampled to uniform 130 Hz

mppg_raw.units: Muse PPG channel ppg1 (forehead); raw optical value (a.u.), resampled to uniform grid

mppg_hr.units: bpm from PPG pulse peaks (0.7-3 Hz band-pass), RR outliers rejected

eda.units: skin conductance uS = 1000 / MS Band GSR resistance (kOhm); band streams ~5 Hz, bin means

band_hr.units: bpm, Microsoft Band optical HR as reported by the device (1 Hz)

muse_gyro.units: Muse headband gyroscope |omega| (deg/s), session-median bias removed, 0.2-s bin mean

muse_tilt.units: deg; head-tilt proxy from Muse accelerometer (g): pitch=atan2(x, sqrt(y^2+z^2)), roll=atan2(y, z). Absolute zero depends on headband fit; use relative changes.

esense_gyro.units: eSense earbud gyroscope |omega| (deg/s) AFTER byte-swap repair: released Gyro_*_deg_per_s columns are big/little-endian swapped (value*65.5 -> int16 -> swap bytes -> /65.5); median bias removed, 0.2-s bin mean

ring_gyro.units: T-Ring gyroscope |omega| in raw int16 counts (scale not documented), median bias removed, 0.2-s bin mean

ring_temp.units: T-Ring temperature/aux channel, mean of temp_0..2, raw int16 counts (device updates ~1 Hz in steps of 100; absolute scale/offset undocumented -> show relative change only)

rppg_raw.units: T-Ring green PPG (finger); raw optical value (a.u.), resampled to uniform grid

notes: rppg_hr omitted: agreement with ECG HR too poor (median |diff|=4.3 bpm, within-5bpm=0.6)
